terms.definition: The degree to which a substance is free from impurities.
An unwanted substance in a material.
terms.example: The impurity level is within limits.

terms.definition: A method to find concentration by adding a reagent.
terms.example: We used titration to measure the acid.

items.title: 3 Pharma Chemistry English words in 30 seconds: purity, impurity, titration #Shorts

• purity /ˈpjʊərəti/ = độ tinh khiết
• impurity /ɪmˈpjʊərəti/ = tạp chất
• titration /taɪˈtreɪʃən/ = chuẩn độ
